semantics.zero: Explicit numeric zero from the source remains 0.
semantics.missing: Missing source values remain null; they are never converted to zero.
semantics.identifiers: SKU, model and location codes retain their exact source values.
semantics.packaging: Dedicated boxes and box-label stickers have no records in this snapshot.
semantics.source_totals: Network quantities, targets, suggested reorder quantities and valuations are copied saved values, not recomputed.

extraction_validation.scope: Structural extraction fidelity only; no physical-stock or Shopify reconciliation.
